evidence_notes: Daniel, 37, has had Crohn's for ten years. He also has ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and chronic kidney disease. He was initially prescribed NSAIDs for back pain, which damaged his kidneys. He was diagnosed with both Crohn's and AS. He started Remicade for both conditions, which worked initially but then stopped. He switched to Humira, which was less effective. He is struggling with quality of life, work, and relationships. He is on disability and is divorced. He is considering surgery for Crohn's but is concerned about recovery with AS. His doctor wants to try Stelara, but his kidney doctor is reluctant.
